name: Mudassir Javed
homeTitle: Mudassir Javed | Security Engineer · Post-Quantum Cryptography
description: Security engineer specializing in post-quantum cryptography, secure authentication, and identity systems. Builder of ScatterID — a production-oriented PQC credential verification framework.
about: I'm Mudassir Javed, a security engineer who designs and hardens systems where cryptography meets real identity infrastructure.

I hold a BS in Cyber Security (KFUEIT, 2022–2026). My capstone, **ScatterID**, is an end-to-end post-quantum credential system built on FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 signatures and salted SHA3-256 commitments. I performed a full self-audit, found and fixed real flaws, and published the code, documentation, and audit history. I finished Top 10 at a national-level CTF, built the scoring platform for my university’s CTF, and mentored 100+ students.

I am currently a Security Engineer at Rynex Security and am looking for information-security roles in banking and fintech where protecting customer identity and data is the core mission. If that describes your team, [get in touch](/contact/).
